user.title: Add a local TP-Link device
user.description: Connect directly to a supported device by IP/hostname. TP-Link Local verifies and, when necessary, asks Home Assistant to install its required python-kasa runtime before contacting the device.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device using its forced local protocol.
error.dependency_unavailable: TP-Link Local could not prepare its required python-kasa runtime. No device commands were attempted. Check Settings > System > Repairs and the Home Assistant log for the exact dependency error.
error.unsupported_device: The device responded but is not supported by this TP-Link Local build.

abort.dl100_no_local_wifi: DL100 was identified locally and remains a required TP-Link Local device. Its local control transport is still under active implementation in this build.

python_kasa_dependency.title: TP-Link Local could not prepare python-kasa
python_kasa_dependency.description: TP-Link Local requires {requirement}. Home Assistant was unable to leave that dependency in a working state. {detail}
